topic: on-site H now vs the calibration batch the model was fitted on
method: white-noise digital injection, 3 segments now vs 6 segments at calibration; H = cross/auto spectrum, n=8192, coherence > 0.7; no external source in either

old_batch.note: the batch the board model was fitted from

b_falsification_test: B asked: if on-site mic/ref at 8.38 kHz differs from the calibration batch by less than 1 dB and 10 degrees, the session-transfer explanation is wrong. Measured: -5.98 dB and +39.5 degrees.
verdict: session transfer CONFIRMED. The 8.4 kHz resonance measured 11.1 dB when the model was fitted and measures 5.2 dB now, so the model over-predicts that band by about 6 dB and cancellation adds energy there instead of removing it. This explains why cancel oscillates at -6 dB while the zero-coefficient arm is stable at 0 dB.
consequence: the model has to be refitted on the current H; no coefficient change can fix a transfer function that is no longer the one being cancelled
